agent_changes.description: Changed to the signature ability slot. (wiki editor note: Because it is a 1 charge ability, cost: 350 credits >>> Free)

EQUIP Cove. ACTIVATE to form a water Smoke in the select location. HOLD FIRE while targeting to move the marker further away and HOLD ALT FIRE to move it closer. RELOAD to toggle targeting view. REACTIVATE to Shield the water Smoke, blocking any bullets that hit it. The Shielded water Smoke can be destroyed.
EQUIP Storm Surge. FIRE to throw, creating an explosive whirlpool that Nearsights and Slows enemies within it after a short duration.
EQUIP Reckoning. FIRE to unleash the full power of your artifact, releasing a surge of water that barrels forward to Nearsight and Slow enemies that are hit.
We've also updated Harbor’s voice lines to reflect his updated abilities. We added conversation voice lines with Tejo and Waylay and have new lines at the start of the match on Abyss and Corrode.
Ruse charges are now restricted to 1 maximum when Clove is dead
Overheal amount, while Pick Me Up is active, has been reduced from 100 HP → 50 HP
Spectators can now see Omen’s perspective in Dark Cover when he is placing his smokes.

competitive_changes: Nerf Starting in 11.10, all Ascendant+ players in NA, LATAM, BR, and KR, must enable Riot Mobile multi-factor authentication (MFA) to access Competitive queue. Other modes will remain unaffected.

Why Ascendant+? Our highest ranked players are capable of inflicting the greatest harm when smurfing and are at risk of more competitive integrity violations as an outcome to sharing accounts – i.e. win trading.

You can check out [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/news/game-updates/riot-mobile-verification-beta/ this article] for more information on why we’re making this change, or get yourself set up with MFA now using [https://support-valorant.riotgames.com/hc/en-us/articles/4415709691667-Multi-Factor-Authentication-How-to-FAQ this how-to guide].
To simplify layered debuff states, all persistent attached debuffs will be removed at once by holding the “Use Object” button.
For example, Cypher's Spycam Dart and Deadlock's GravNet will both be removed if they happen to be stacked on you at the same time.
bug_fixes: General

Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug where players could plant the spike outside or float partially above the site's designated area. The spike will now stay within the outlined site area no matter where you are facing in game.
Bugfix Fixed a bug where bots in The Range would not show flash VFX when hit by screen blind effects.
Bugfix Fixed a bug that caused certain abilities to apply status effects to dead players and show in the Combat Report.
Agents
General Agents
Bugfix Nerf Abilities that cause vulnerable will not grant assists after the vulnerable effect has ended.
Bugfix Fixed an issue on the Kill effects at the sides of the screen where they'd look misaligned when playing in left-handed mode
Clove
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Clove would sometimes revive in unexpected locations when casting Not Dead Yet
Bugfix Nerf Fixed a bug that allowed Clove to use Not Dead Yet after falling off the edge of Abyss
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug that incorrectly teleported Clove to spawn when teleporting back from Iso’s Kill Contract
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Clove would be moved into a wall if their body was intersecting Sage’s Barrier Orb
Cypher
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Cypher's Neural Theft would sometimes display a blank icon on the minimap
Harbor
Bugfix Harbor’s Cove now grants assists for players killed while affected by it.
Bugfix Nerf Viper’s Snake Bite, Brimstone’s Incendiary, Sova’s Hunter's Fury, and Killjoy’s Nanoswarm should properly damage Harbor’s Cove
KAY/O
Bugfix Fixed a bug where the killfeed wasn’t showing the proper headshot icon if KAY/O was the last player to die while NULL/cmd was active.
Killjoy
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where the minimap icons for Alarmbot and Turret would occasionally disappear when deactivated outside their active ranges.
Bugfix Nerf Fixed inaccurate hit detection on Killjoy's Alarmbot while it is jumping
Omen
Bugfix Fixed Dark Cover’s minimap to match the darkness of other dome smokes.
Bugfix Fixed minimap icon size for Omen’s Paranoia
Reyna
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Reyna’s Leer projectile would animate forward in the incorrect direction while jumping and rapidly changing her aim location.
Sage
Bugfix Fixed an issue where Sage’s Resurrection indicator was snapping to allies out of Sage’s POV.
Bugfix Fixed a bug that caused Sage’s hands to flicker briefly when using Healing Orb on an ally.
Bugfix Fixed a bug where Sage’s Slow Orb was making a popping sound when intersecting Cosmic Divide.
Veto
Bugfix Crosscut targeting should be more consistent now to other targetable usables.
Bugfix Fixed a bug with Veto’s animation while recalling Interceptor.
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug where Crosscut was invisible or non-functional when used in Buy Phase with high ping or packet loss.
Vyse
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug with Razorvine's decals being able to be seen under certain platforms.
Bugfix Buff Fixed a bug with Razorvine’s projectile where it wouldn’t disappear upon landing.
Yoru
Bugfix Buff Yoru’s Fakeout clone will now properly show suppression VFX when affected by suppression.
Bugfix Observers are now able to see Yoru’s Blindside immediately instead of after it bounces.
Bugfix Yoru’s Blindside will display the correct color VFX when there are two Yoru’s in the same match.
Bugfix Buff Fixed bug where Blindside’s audio was audible by enemies while stealthed.
Replays

Replays are now live for consoles! Check out the Replays FAQ [https://playvalorant.com/en-us/news/dev/replays-everything-you-need-to-know/ here] for detailed information and answers to commonly asked questions about the feature.
You can now tab over to the Lobby like any other page, or use the shortcut button.
Custom game lobbies have been moved into the ‘Select a Queue’ page.
The layouts of the ‘Select a Queue’ and ‘Map’ pages have been updated.
When in queue, the active queue timer will now appear in the top left corner of the Main Menu HUD
Client
The queue timer sometimes doesn’t reset when disconnecting and reconnecting with the timer active.
Disconnecting and reconnecting then queuing can make it impossible to cancel the queue.
Restarting the game fixes this issue.
Custom Lobby
The lobby type changes back to Matchmaking when finishing a Custom Lobby Match.
Party members cannot view custom game options or changes made by the party leader.
“Choose a Mode” is currently displayed instead of “Choose a Queue” on the queue select screen.
Added You can now view Premier team information from standings, invites, and your social panel.
View a team’s Roster, Zone, Division, and current Premier Score by:
Right clicking on any team on the Premier standings and choosing ‘View Team’
Right clicking on a friend on the social panel and choosing ‘View Team’ **Clicking ‘View Team’ on a Premier invite you’ve received
